name: Avelio Reviews for WooCommerce
author: Ondelab

sections.description:
Avelio Reviews for WooCommerce asks your customers for a review a few days after their order, and saves their answers as native WooCommerce reviews. Everything runs on your own site.

Why Avelio Reviews

  • Everything stays on your site. No external service, no account to create, no API key. Requests, reviews, photos and statistics stay in your WordPress database, and emails are sent by your site, from your shop’s address.
  • Your brand only. The email and the review form use your logo, colours and texts, with a live preview. Nothing from a third party is added to what your customers see (an optional credit line is off by default).
  • Native WooCommerce reviews. Reviews are saved in the standard WooCommerce system: the “Verified purchase” badge, average ratings, your theme and the structured data of your SEO plugin keep working, and your reviews stay in place if you ever stop using the plugin.
  • Respectful of your customers. One-click unsubscribe, no new request or resend once an order has been reviewed, automatic purge of personal data, and sending suspended on staging copies of your site.
  • Reply to your customers, in public. Answer any review in one click from the Reviews screen: your reply appears right below it, on your review page and on the product page. One reply per review, from the shop only: no comment threads under your reviews.
  • Built for consumer law. A ready-made notice explains how reviews are collected and how customers can modify or delete their review, as required in France by article L111-7-2 of the Consumer Code. The “Verified purchase” badge only shows on reviews linked to an order.
  • Easy switch from Customer Reviews for WooCommerce (CusRev). A built-in migration links existing reviews to their orders, imports the send history and stops the old reminders, without sending anything twice.

Review requests

  • Sent a chosen number of days after the order reaches the status of your choice, at the hour of your choice.
  • Scheduled with the WooCommerce Action Scheduler: requests are never sent twice, and a server cron job keeps the sending time exact on low-traffic stores.
  • Manual requests and resends from the orders list or the order screen, with a full timeline per order.
  • Exclusions: product categories, free products, products the customer has already reviewed, guest orders.

Email and review form

  • Subject, texts, button, signature, logo and colours editable from the admin, with a live desktop and mobile preview and a test send.
  • A review form without a customer account, opened from a secure, time-limited link.
  • One rating per product and an optional shop rating, customer photos, and a choice of displayed name.
  • Templates can be overridden from your theme.

Reviews and dashboard

  • Moderation, public replies and featured reviews in one screen, with a “Without reply” filter to find the reviews still waiting for an answer.
  • Shop replies shown below the reviews: dated, with your own label (for example “The {shop_name} team”), long replies folded with “Read more”. Shown in the review list by default and in the review grid on request.
  • A trash for deleted reviews: restore them, delete them for good with their replies, or empty it in one click. “Undo” right after a deletion.
  • Dashboard with requests sent, open and response rates, rating breakdown, best products and products still without reviews.
  • Shortcodes for a full review list with filters, a review grid, a rating badge and the legal notice.

Google Shopping

  • Optional product reviews feed in Google’s format for Google Merchant Center, refreshed every night, using the GTIN, SKU and brands of your WooCommerce products.

Languages

  • Available in English and French.

Avelio Reviews for WooCommerce requires WooCommerce. It does not connect to any external service.

Avelio Reviews Pro

Everything above is free, with no limit on orders, requests or reviews. Avelio Reviews Pro is a paid add-on for stores that want more reviews:

  • Follow-up reminders: up to two reminders when no review has been left, each with its own subject, title, text and button.
  • “Your review is published” email: one email per order, listing the reviews that went live.
  • Review rewards: an optional discount code sent with that email, whatever the rating.
  • Per-step statistics: emails sent, opens and reviews obtained for the request and each reminder.
  • Reply notifications: customers are told by email when you reply to their review.
  • Private messages: answer a customer by email from the Reviews screen, without publishing anything.
  • Review updates: invite a customer to update their review through a personal, prefilled link; the new version is shown with its update date.

The Pro add-on has a 30-day free trial. It is sold and licensed on getondelab.com; this free plugin works fully without it.

Documentation and support

  • Product page and documentation: getondelab.com/avelio-reviews and getondelab.com/docs.
  • Questions and bug reports: the plugin’s support forum on WordPress.org.
sections.installation:
1. Plugins > Add New Plugin: search for “Avelio Reviews for WooCommerce”, then Install and Activate. You can also upload the avelio-reviews-for-woocommerce.zip file with Upload Plugin.
  2. Customer reviews > Email and Form: set the appearance.
  3. Customer reviews > Settings: choose the triggering status and the delay, then enable requests.
  4. If CusRev is installed: Settings > Migration from CusRev > Run the migration, replace the listed CusRev shortcodes with their Avelio equivalents, then deactivate CusRev.
sections.faq:
Do my customers need an account to leave a review?

No. Each request contains a personal, time-limited link (30 days by default) that opens the review form directly.

Where are the reviews stored?

In the native WooCommerce review system. Ratings, the “Verified purchase” badge and the structured data of your theme or SEO plugin keep working as before.

How do I display reviews on a page?

Use the shortcodes [avelio_reviews] (full list with summary and filters), [avelio_grid] (selected reviews), [avelio_badge] (rating badge) and [avelio_reviews_notice] (notice about how reviews are collected).

Where do my replies to reviews appear?

Below the review: in the [avelio_reviews] list (setting “Show the shop’s replies below reviews”, on by default), in the [avelio_grid] grid with replies=”yes”, and on product pages through your theme. The label shown above each reply is set in Customer reviews > Settings > Display blocks, or per block with reply_label. To hide replies on one block, add replies=”no”.

Can customers answer my reply?

No. As on Google or Trustpilot, each review gets one public reply, from the shop. On product pages, replying to a review is reserved for accounts that can moderate comments, so no discussion thread can grow under your reviews. A customer who wants to react can contact you, and you can update your reply at any time.

Can I restore a review I deleted?

Yes. Deleted reviews go to the trash: open the “Trash” filter of the Reviews screen to restore them or delete them for good. WordPress empties the trash automatically after 30 days. Right after a deletion, you can also click “Undo”.

Can I customize the email and the form beyond the settings?

Yes. Copy the templates into your theme: your-theme/avelio-reviews/email.php and your-theme/avelio-reviews/form.php.

What happens on a staging copy of my site?

When the site runs at another address than the one where the plugin was activated, sending is suspended automatically, so customers never receive requests from a staging site. A notice lets you confirm the new address if the site has really moved.

Does the plugin add a credit or a link to my emails?

Not by default. You can choose to show “Sent with Avelio Reviews by Ondelab” at the bottom of review request emails in Customer reviews > Email, to support the plugin. It is off unless you turn it on.

How do I show my star ratings in Google Shopping?

Turn on the product reviews feed in Customer reviews > Settings > Google Shopping, then add the feed address shown there as a product reviews feed in Google Merchant Center. The feed lists your published product reviews with the reviewer’s first name and initial, and uses the GTIN (EAN), SKU and brand of your WooCommerce products to match them. Google’s own conditions apply, including a minimum number of reviews.

Can developers extend the plugin?

Yes. Avelio Reviews provides actions and filters for the request lifecycle (sent, failed, cancelled, review received), the email content and template variables, the admin screens and the settings. They are listed in the changelog of version 1.8.0.

What personal data does the plugin store?

For each request: the order number, the customer’s email address and name, a hash of the secure link and the dates of sending, opening and review. Email opening is measured with an image served by your own site; you can turn it off in Settings. Names and email addresses are erased automatically after the retention period set in Settings. Unsubscribed customers are stored as a hash of their email address only. Nothing is sent to Ondelab or to any third party.
sections.changelog:
1.9.1

  • Reviews updated by their author show their update date (“Updated on…”) next to the review, on product pages, in the review blocks and on the Reviews screen.
  • Default notice on how reviews are collected: now explains how customers can modify or delete their review. Existing sites keep their own text.
  • Replies written from the WordPress Comments screen or from the product page now trigger the same events as replies written from the Reviews screen.
  • New: trash in the Reviews screen. Deleted reviews go to a “Trash” filter where you can restore them or delete them permanently (with their replies), or empty the trash. “Undo” right after deleting a review, and “Restore the deleted reply” on a review whose reply was deleted.
  • Emails without an unsubscribe link no longer show an empty link.
  • Default texts (emails, form, notice) are shown in the site’s language in the settings screens, as customers will see them, and are no longer saved when you leave them unchanged: they stay in the site’s language even if your own account uses another language.
  • “New customer review” email to the administrator: product names with “&” or quotes are shown correctly, and the link opens the Reviews screen (pending reviews when moderation is on) instead of the dashboard.
  • Reviews screen: a review that no longer matches the filter shown (for example approved from the “Pending” list) disappears from the list right away, and the filter counts and the pending badges (Reviews tab, WordPress menu) are updated without reloading.
  • Pro tab, dashboard and readme: presentation of the new Avelio Reviews Pro features (reply notifications, private messages, review updates).
  • For developers: actions avelio_admin_review_actions and avelio_admin_review_card_after; filters avelio_admin_review_filters, avelio_pending_count and avelio_form_args; Avelio_Email::send_custom() can find the order’s request by itself and accepts an ignore_optout option for individual messages.

1.9.0

  • Shop replies are now shown below reviews in the [avelio_reviews] list by default (new setting “Show the shop’s replies below reviews”; replies=”no” hides them on one block).
  • New: replies in the [avelio_grid] grid with replies=”yes”.
  • Reply block redesigned: label, reply date, line breaks kept, long replies folded with “Read more”. New options: reply_label, reply_background, reply_logo=”yes” (logo of the email).
  • New setting “Label of the shop’s replies” (Settings > Display blocks), with the {shop_name} variable. The French default now reads “Réponse de l’équipe {shop name}”.
  • Reviews screen: “Delete reply” button, reply date, and a new “Without reply” filter.
  • Product pages: the “Reply” link below reviews is reserved for accounts that can moderate comments, and replies from customers or visitors to a review are refused.
  • Replies are read in a single query for the whole list.
  • Buttons of the review list (rating filter, “Show more”, “Read more”) keep their look whatever the theme’s button styles.
  • For developers: actions avelio_review_replied, avelio_review_reply_deleted and avelio_admin_reply_box; filters avelio_review_reply_html, avelio_is_shop_reply and avelio_reserve_review_replies.

1.8.6

  • New “Pro” tab presenting the Avelio Reviews Pro add-on, shown only when the add-on is not installed.
  • Dashboard: a short presentation of Avelio Reviews Pro, shown only when the add-on is not installed. Each user can hide it.
  • Plugins screen: “Get Pro” link to the Avelio Reviews Pro page on getondelab.com, shown only when the add-on is not installed.
  • Fix: the “Settings” link of the Plugins screen now opens the Settings screen (it opened the dashboard).
  • Readme: presentation of Avelio Reviews Pro.

1.8.5

  • Security: the public review form and the opt-out confirmation are now protected by a nonce, in addition to the secret link token. A page left open too long shows the form again with the customer’s input kept.
  • Translations are now provided by translate.wordpress.org: the bundled .po/.mo files and the load_plugin_textdomain() call are removed.
  • Code: core admin files are only loaded when needed (cron and table creation).
  • Readme: clearer description of sending on low-traffic stores.

1.8.4

  • Review form: separate thank-you message when moderation is off (“Your review is now online…”), editable in the Form screen. The message shown follows the “Review submissions before publishing” setting; before, the page always said the review would be published after being checked.
  • Fix: links in emails already sent no longer lead to a “page not found” when the form address changes (in the settings, or when the site language changes, as the default address is translated). Every address used since 1.8.4, plus the default English one, keeps working.
  • Settings: when moderation is off, a note reminds you to check that the legal notice does not say reviews are checked before publishing.

1.8.3

  • New setting “Ask again about a product the customer has already reviewed”: never, after 6 months, after 12 months (default) or always. Replaces the “Don’t ask again” option: when it was off, the new setting is “always”.
  • Fix: the review form now offers exactly the products listed in the email (products already reviewed by the customer are left out according to the setting above).
  • Fix: once a review has been received for an order, the links of the other emails of the sequence (request or reminders) show “Review already received” instead of accepting a second review.
  • Faster orders list: whether an order has a review is cached on the order, and refreshed when one of its reviews changes status or is deleted.
  • Google Shopping feed: reviews flagged as incentivized by an extension are sent with is_incentivized_review.
  • New filter for extensions: avelio_error_label (labels of their own cancellation reasons).
  • Admin forms no longer accept browser autofill (an autofilled login could overwrite the email subject).
  • Settings: the hint of the legal notice no longer refers to France only.

1.8.2

  • Dashboard: requests sent, open rate and response rate are counted once per request, follow-up emails included (an opened or reviewed follow-up counts for its request).
  • New action for extensions: avelio_admin_dashboard_after_kpis.

1.8.1

  • An order that already has a review (submitted with Avelio Reviews or imported from Customer Reviews for WooCommerce, published or awaiting moderation) no longer offers to resend the request or to send a new one.

1.8.0

  • Google Shopping: product reviews feed (Google Product Reviews 2.4 format) for Google Merchant Center, to show your star ratings in Google Shopping. Off by default; turn it on in Customer reviews > Settings. Regenerated every night or on demand; uses the WooCommerce GTIN, SKU and brands.
  • Requests table ready for follow-up emails (sequence step and original request); updated automatically.
  • When a review is received, any follow-up still scheduled for the same order sequence is cancelled.
  • Once a review is received for an order (from the request or a follow-up), the request can no longer be resent and no new request is offered for that order.
  • Requests list: a cancelled request that was never sent shows its planned date struck through, marked “Not sent”.
  • The display-name choice made by the customer is saved with each review.
  • Shop reviews are linked to their request.
  • Ready for a “your review is published” email from extensions: event fired once per review on its first publication (after moderation, or on submission when moderation is off), shared email sender and template, unsubscribe link valid in every Avelio email.
  • New hooks for extensions: avelio_request_sent (with the origin of the send: auto, send_now, manual or resend), avelio_request_failed, avelio_request_cancelled, avelio_review_received, avelio_review_published, avelio_email_settings, avelio_email_vars, avelio_email_args, avelio_admin_tabs, avelio_admin_view, avelio_section_keys, avelio_settings_defaults, avelio_sanitize_setting, avelio_step_label, avelio_admin_email_before_editor, avelio_admin_settings_after_trigger. Developer methods Avelio_Requests::schedule_followup(), Avelio_Email::send_custom() and Avelio_Reviews::order_reviews(). Feed filters: avelio_feed_review, avelio_feed_product_ids.

1.7.1

  • Optional credit “Sent with Avelio Reviews by Ondelab” at the bottom of review request emails. Off by default; turn it on in Customer reviews > Email.
  • Plugin name and publisher shown in the footer of the plugin’s admin pages.

1.7.0

  • Plugin renamed “Avelio Reviews for WooCommerce”: new slug and text domain avelio-reviews-for-woocommerce, main file avelio-reviews-for-woocommerce.php. Existing sites: install it, deactivate the old “Avelio Reviews” plugin, activate this one (settings and data are kept), then delete the old plugin.
  • Code prefix renamed from “avr” to “avelio” (WordPress.org requirement). Settings, tables, review data and scheduled requests are migrated automatically when the plugin is updated.
  • Template variables prefixed. If you copied email.php or form.php into your theme, copy them again from this version.
  • The [avelio_reviews] script and the standalone review form now load their files through the WordPress script and style API.
  • Translator comments added for every text with a placeholder.
  • “Requires Plugins: woocommerce” header (WordPress 6.5+).
  • Requests and resends always go to the order’s current billing email, even if it was corrected after the request was created.
  • Review form: photos selected one after another now add up (up to the allowed number), each with a button to remove it. Previously each new selection replaced the previous one.
  • The “Customer reviews” menu now sits right after “Comments” in the admin sidebar.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.

1.6.0

  • The plugin is now in English by default, with a bundled French translation (languages/avelio-reviews-fr_FR.po/.mo), also used for fr_BE, fr_CA and the other French locales.
  • All texts are translatable, including the admin and form scripts, order notes, the admin notification email and the default email and form texts.
  • Dates follow a translatable format.
  • Request failure and cancellation reasons are stored as codes and translated on display; reasons saved by earlier versions are still recognised.
  • Texts already saved in the settings are kept as they are.
  • Emails and the review form always use the site language, even when an admin using another language sends a manual request or views the previews.

1.5.5

  • New logo (star bubble): admin menu, Avelio page headers and icons for wordpress.org.

1.5.4

  • Publisher: Ondelab.

1.5.3

  • Text variables in English: {first_name}, {last_name}, {order_date}, {order_number}, {shop_name}, {product_list}. Texts already saved are converted automatically.

1.5.2

  • Email: “Sender address” setting. When empty, requests are sent from the WooCommerce email address.

1.5.1

  • Email: header colour separate from the main colour (button, links), for a dark logo on a light header. Subtle rule under a very light header.

1.5.0

  • Orders list: button to resend a request that was sent, or to send a first request to eligible orders, without opening the order.

1.4.1

  • Orders: the most recent request is determined by its date (not by the order it was saved in), which fixes the display of orders migrated from CusRev.
  • Order screen: “Send a request” offered when the last request comes from CusRev without a known address.

1.4.0

  • Orders: “Reviews” column in the list (status of the last request, details on hover).
  • Order screen: “Avelio reviews” box with the tracking of each request, the reviews received and the actions (send now, resend, cancel, send a request).

1.3.4

  • [avelio_reviews]: the summary shows “N reviews” instead of “N verified reviews”, since not every review is necessarily linked to an order.

1.3.3

  • Shop reviews migrated from CusRev: detected on the WooCommerce Shop page (where CusRev stores them). Fix applied automatically to migrations already done.
  • Blocks, the dashboard and the “Shop reviews” filter take all shop reviews into account.
  • [avelio_reviews]: the average rating and the number of reviews cover all published reviews; min_length now only filters the displayed list.

1.3.2

  • [avelio_reviews]: adjustable card and bar colours (card_background, card_border, bar_color); bars follow the star colour by default.

1.3.1

  • Neutral default palette (email, form, blocks).
  • New “Reviews page” setting for the badge link.

1.3.0

  • Avelio’s own shortcodes: [avelio_badge], [avelio_grid], [avelio_reviews], with explicit parameters.
  • CusRev shortcodes are no longer supported: the migration screen lists the contents to update.

1.2.1

  • CusRev mentions (migration, shortcodes) only appear on sites that used it.

1.2.0

  • Full separation: after the migration (or without CusRev), Avelio only reads its own data.
  • Migration completed: photos hosted by CusRev and orders already solicited.
  • Fixed the display of the migration confirmation button.

1.1.1

  • Review summary: neutralises the theme’s button style.

1.1.0

  • Display blocks: trust badge, review grid, full list with a filterable summary.
  • Automatic takeover of CusRev shortcodes when CusRev is deactivated.
  • Fixed photo thumbnails in the reviews list.

1.0.2

  • Form: full-width display in grid themes (WoodMart).

1.0.1

  • Text colour adjusted automatically when the contrast is too low (email and form).
  • SVG logo replaced by the shop name in the email, with a warning.

1.0.0

  • First release.

upgrade_notice.1.9.1: Shows the update date of reviews modified by their author, and adds extension points used by Avelio Reviews Pro 1.1.
upgrade_notice.1.9.0: Your replies to reviews now appear below them in the [avelio_reviews] list. To keep them hidden, turn off "Show the shop's replies below reviews" in Settings, or add replies="no" to the shortcode.
upgrade_notice.1.8.6: New Pro tab presenting the optional Avelio Reviews Pro add-on, and a fix for the Settings link of the Plugins screen.
upgrade_notice.1.8.5: Security hardening of the review form and opt-out page. Translations now come from translate.wordpress.org.
upgrade_notice.1.8.4: Review links from emails already sent keep working after a change of the form address or of the site language. Without moderation, the thank-you page now says the review is online.
upgrade_notice.1.8.3: A customer who buys a product again can be asked for a new review after 6 or 12 months (new setting, 12 months by default). The review form now matches the products of the email, and a second review from a reminder link is no longer possible once the order has been reviewed.
upgrade_notice.1.8.1: No more resend button on orders that already have a review, including reviews imported from Customer Reviews for WooCommerce.
upgrade_notice.1.7.0: Internal prefix renamed for WordPress.org: your data is migrated automatically. If you override the email or form template in your theme, copy it again.
